title: climate-river-coastal-ml: Climate-Driven River-Coastal Connectivity Across Puerto Rico
description: Analysis code and machine-readable supplementary materials for a multi-basin study testing whether local drought conditions (SPI) predict river discharge across Puerto Rico watersheds better than ENSO, and whether discharge is detectably and specifically associated with coastal chlorophyll-a, using nested cross-validation, conditional permutation tests, and SHAP-based explainability.
